My name is Ted from Myanmar. I received orthodontic treatment at V Smile Dental Clinic for one year after beginning my treatment at Green Dental Clinic in Mae Sot for six months. Since I needed to move to Chiang Mai for educational purposes, I had to continue my treatment at another clinic. My first dentist, Dr. Bank from Green Dental Clinic, strongly recommended Dr. Tanny at V Smile Dental Clinic, which is why I ultimately chose this clinic.

From my very first contact with V Smile Dental Clinic, I was deeply impressed by the friendliness and professionalism of the staff. In particular, Dr. Tanny was always kind, patient, and thorough in explaining the treatment procedures, progress, expected results, and estimated treatment timeline. She was also incredibly attentive to all of my detailed questions during each monthly visit, which made me feel comfortable and confident throughout the entire treatment process.

I especially appreciated how responsible and thoughtful the staff members were. They consistently reminded me of my appointments one day in advance, which was extremely helpful for someone like me who often struggles to keep track of dates and times amidst a busy daily schedule.

Overall, choosing V Smile Dental Clinic was one of the best decisions I made, and I have never regretted it for a moment. I will always remember the kindness, friendliness, professionalism, and responsible care provided by Dr. Tanny and the entire staff.

Thank you so much to Dr. Tanny and everyone at the clinic for your incredible service and care!

So, from our experience this clinic is trustworthy and therefore we recommend it. The facilities were quite good and the staff very nice.

I was passing and enquired regarding a clean and whitening on a Thursday 9th Dec, as they didn’t have any weekend appointments they made time for me on Friday 10th Dec.

The team were fantastic explained everything throughly, the costs were extremely reasonable, I am delighted with the results, I would highly recommend

Prompt, professional, low key. I got a cleaning and a filling, and the staff and dentist were calm, helpful, communicative, and respectful. The only reason 4 stars and not 5 is that it was casual in just the way I like, but I know some that might feel uncomfortable if they are accustomed to a more polished environment. It took 30min and cost 1000 baht (less than $30). It was the easiest, most affordable, most painless, most guiltless, most comfortable dental experience I've ever had.
